steps.note: R16 (design C1, D1). The Director is punched before the brief and left standing: hostile for good, he won't talk. The hostile latch counts as the brief (brief_taken, brief_with_netherton), the second controls text names the naming, not the card. HaX's server-room topic sends the player to the printer; her ladder and her reading treat 'hostile' as 'unavailable'; the audit-arrived and flag-4 texts have hostile twins. Named by HaX before the debrief, which has its own hostile lines, as do the credits.
